title: millennium project config
description: Schema for .millennium/config.json, for editor completion and validation. The gate engine is the authority and also enforces rules this schema cannot express (no '.' or '..' path segments, react-feature-based needs typescript in its component, mypy needs python, the most specific component wins). engine/internal/infrastructure/configfile/schema_sync_test.go keeps the two in step.

prefixPattern.description: A path relative to the repository root, '.' for the root itself. '*' and '?' match within one segment.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema for editors.

languages.description: Single-project form: languages whose checks run. Use components instead for a monorepo.

conventions.description: Single-project form: convention packs to enforce.

components.description: Monorepo form: each component maps paths to languages and conventions. A file belongs to the most specific matching component.

layers.description: Overrides a convention's layer paths for this component, relative to its root.

reason.description: Why this component is an exception, for example a legacy service with no conventions.

exclude.description: Paths no check reads, such as generated or vendored code. '**' matches any number of segments; a directory excludes everything inside it.

dependencyPolicy.description: How strictly new dependencies are gated.

typeCheck.description: Python type checker. When set to mypy, a missing mypy blocks.

lint.description: Shell linter. shellcheck is on by default and then required: a missing shellcheck blocks.

acceptanceTests.description: Directory of qa-tester's black-box regression tests, relative to the repository root. The engineer agent cannot change it.

run.description: How qa-tester starts the software under test.

healthUrl.description: Health endpoint to wait for. Must be on localhost or a loopback address.
